name: com.stream.webrtcstream
description: Plug-and-play GPU-accelerated WebRTC video streaming for Unity. Wraps com.unity.webrtc + NativeWebSocket signaling behind a simple StartStreaming()/StopStreaming() API.

samples.description: A scene showing a streamed camera, rotate control, and telemetry wired up with GenericStreamController/GenericControlReceiver/GenericTelemetryProvider.
